description: The plain-text projection of an AI answer (ToPlainText): markdown markers are dropped while the block structure survives, so a copied or spoken answer reads like the answer instead of like its source. Link and image targets never travel — only their label (or alt text) — and the walk runs over the same safe Markdig pipeline the renderer uses, so raw HTML stays literal text.

members.name: ToPlainText
members.description: Projects untrusted markdown to readable plain text: one line per paragraph, list item (with a plain bullet or its number), code line and table row, blank lines between blocks, and '\n' line endings. Null or whitespace projects to an empty string.

examples.title: Copy an answer as the reader sees it
